'''Caline Metara''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who commanded the [[Alderaanian gunship]] [[Aegis (Alderaanian gunship)|''Aegis'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Metara and the crew of the ''Aegis'' turned to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Metara was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the pirate [[Aral tukor Viest]].
